metadata.value: This project attempts to embed a story into a music playlist by sorting the playlist (i.e., sequencing it) so that the order of the music follows a narrative arc. The music tracks are fitted to a fixed narrative template based on the output of a machine learning model, which itself distills each track down to its narrative essence.

metadata.evidence:
Before installation, first, ensure you have a recent version of Python and pip, then clone the repository using the `--sparse` option:
```bash
git clone --sparse git@github.com:dylanashley/story-distiller.git
```
metadata.reason: Defines the first installation step (sparse clone) for setting up the tool.

metadata.evidence:
Afterwards, install the Python dependencies using pip:
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
metadata.reason: Defines the dependency installation step required to run the tool.

metadata.evidence: To use the full suite of file types supported by the tool, it is also necessary to separately install the [ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/) tool by following the instructions for your operating system provided on [their website](https://ffmpeg.org/download.html).
metadata.reason: Names an external system dependency required for full file-type support.

metadata.evidence:
You can now run the tool by directly executing the `__main__.py` file, or—if you're using Linux or macOS—you can use the makefile to compile and then install an executable Python zip archive:
```bash
make all
sudo make install
```

metadata.normalized_value: album_extractor.py, movie_extractor.py, template_learner.py, fit_values in __main__.py, data/, results/
metadata.evidence:
- the scripts needed to learn the PyTorch models for extracting the narrative essence from either music albums (`album_extractor.py`) or movie frames (`movie_extractor.py`) and compute the lower bounds for the mutual information of the different features,
- the scripts for learning a set of template curves from scalar descriptions of items in a set of collections (`template_learner.py`),
- the code that can fit the scalar descriptions of items in a collection to a given template curve (`fit_values` in `__main__.py`),
- the preprocessed album data used to train the original PyTorch models for the music albums (`data/`), and
- the learned PyTorch models and template curves (`results/`).
metadata.reason: Enumerates the training scripts, fitting code, preprocessed data, and learned models/templates included for reproducing the paper's results.

metadata.evidence:
Note that to obtain the preprocessed data and the learned PyTorch models and template curves, you will have to clone the repository without using the `--sparse` option:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:dylanashley/story-distiller.git
```
metadata.reason: Defines the clone step required to obtain the preprocessed data and learned models needed for reproduction.
